overridableConfigKeys.label: Alignment
overridableConfigKeys.description: Center the copy, or align it to the start edge

overridableConfigKeys.label: Backdrop
overridableConfigKeys.description: A scene behind the whole block, such as an animated canvas; it fills the block, never takes clicks, and the copy stays on top. Empty by default.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Background photo focus
overridableConfigKeys.description: Which part of the photo stays visible when it is cropped

overridableConfigKeys.label: Background photo
overridableConfigKeys.description: Photo URL filling the block behind the copy when the surface is image
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: background image, hero photo, cover photo

overridableConfigKeys.label: Command
overridableConfigKeys.description: A shell command shown in a copyable code box under the actions, e.g. an install one-liner; empty hides it

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bottom edge
overridableConfigKeys.description: Shape cut into the bottom of the block; curve uses the theme's shape

overridableConfigKeys.label: Edge fill
overridableConfigKeys.description: The surface of the neighbouring section, which fills the cut

overridableConfigKeys.label: Top edge
overridableConfigKeys.description: Shape cut into the top of the block; curve uses the theme's shape

overridableConfigKeys.label: Eyebrow
overridableConfigKeys.description: Small badge above the headline; empty hides it

overridableConfigKeys.label: Headline
overridableConfigKeys.description: Main headline

overridableConfigKeys.label: Height
overridableConfigKeys.description: auto fits the copy; tall fills most of the screen with the copy centred, for a hero over a backdrop scene

overridableConfigKeys.label: Illustration
overridableConfigKeys.description: Inline SVG shown beside or below the copy instead of the media image; empty uses the media image

overridableConfigKeys.label: Supporting text
overridableConfigKeys.description: One or two sentences under the headline; empty hides it

overridableConfigKeys.label: Home look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Figures always sit right under the greeting. Staff: command = then actions and sections; briefing = then sections in the main column with actions and shortcut links in a side rail; launchpad = then big shortcut tiles. Customers: spotlight = photo or gradient hero, then actions, tiles and their items; concierge = centred greeting, then shortcut tiles.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: dashboard style, home layout, overview layout, admin home, customer home

overridableConfigKeys.description: spotlight and concierge: inline SVG beside the greeting; empty hides it

overridableConfigKeys.description: Label of the one most important thing to do next, shown in the header; empty hides it

overridableConfigKeys.label: Overview sections

overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: widgets, panels, recent, upcoming, activity, needs attention

overridableConfigKeys.label: Shortcuts
overridableConfigKeys.description: Links to the pages people go to most: label, href, optional icon, one-line description, button label and whether it is the primary one
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: quick links, go to, jump to, navigation tiles

overridableConfigKeys.label: Summary
